name: use-notifications
title: useNotifications
description: useNotifications: the notifications block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the notifications block (`npx better-supabase add notifications`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/notifications.
